title: Business Office Review and Hold Periods for the Patient Financial Account
content:
The business office applies the following per-class figures to reviews opened on a Patient Financial Account: the maximum percentage of a charge's remaining balance that an approved financial-hardship review may adjust off; the business days within which a complete financial-hardship application is decided; the calendar days after the statement date that first billed a charge within which the patient may dispute that charge; the maximum calendar days an account may stay on billing hold for one dispute before the hold must be released; and the calendar days the account of a deceased patient stays on estate-review hold before statements go to the estate representative.

| Financial class (tier) | Hardship adjustment maximum (%) | Hardship decision (business days) | Dispute window (calendar days) | Dispute hold maximum (calendar days) | Estate-review hold (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | 100.00 | 10 | 60 | 45 | 90 |
| Self-Pay Account | 100.00 | 7 | 60 | 45 | 90 |
| Medicare Part B Account | 100.00 | 10 | 60 | 45 | 90 |
| Medicare Advantage Account | 100.00 | 10 | 60 | 45 | 90 |
| Commercial HMO/EPO Account | 75.00 | 10 | 60 | 45 | 90 |
| Commercial PPO/POS Account | 75.00 | 10 | 60 | 45 | 90 |
| High-Deductible Health Plan Account | 75.00 | 10 | 60 | 45 | 90 |

**Standing observations.** The hardship maximum is 100.00 percent on the Medicaid Managed Care, Self-Pay, Medicare Part B and Medicare Advantage accounts and 75.00 percent on the three commercial classes. The Self-Pay Account decides a complete hardship application within 7 business days; every other class within 10. The dispute window (60 days), the dispute hold maximum (45 days) and the estate-review hold (90 days) do not vary by class.
